Compare with notes/cp_0.txt (r11: logging_simulator + bag, planning/control idle).

Session
-------
  fish_20260817_172259 (r18): planning_simulator.launch.xml, sample-map-rosbag,
  image autoware-dev-trt-a1000-fishwait5 + current fish_interfere, per_instance,
  rmw_cyclonedds_cpp, no bag (replay_rosbag=false), rviz off.
  Scenario: /api/localization/initialize with an explicit pose (start of lanelet 1),
  /api/routing/set_route_points (goal ~85 m ahead on the same lanelet),
  /api/operation_mode/change_to_autonomous → success (mode 2). The vehicle drove
  to the goal (ego pose = goal pose at the end; trajectory 152→47 points while
  approaching). 11.87 M LTTng events, 0 discarded; model: 3995 nodes / 12165
  edges; 7 join outputs; 107 inferred state links; 1367 msg edges with hop
  latency (9.26 M publish↔take pairs); 106 state edges with data age.
  Caveat: the goal injector's `ros2 topic hz/echo` CLI processes are traced too
  (they appear as ROSTopicHz F's under '/', 69 nodes/121 F) — filter them
  (_ros2cli_*) in the next model pass.

Why not AWSIM (r12–r17): see notes/about_docs/awsim_setup.txt. Short: AWSIM
windowed = 3.7 GB VRAM (Autoware CUDA OOM); -nographics = 0.48 GB but no GNSS;
explicit init works, but NDT never constrains yaw against the Shinjuku
pointcloud map (NVTL 2.15–2.2 for any yaw; 8 inits → 8 different yaws), so the
planner sees the ego off-route. Needs a map that matches the AWSIM Lightweight
scene. Everything else on that path is solved and scripted.

Verdict vs the architecture picture (compare cp_0)
--------------------------------------------------
  cp_0 (r11) missing arrows: Perception→Planning, Planning→Control — "no route".
  cp_1 (r18): the loop is CLOSED through Autoware's own plant:
      Planning → (plant) → Localization(sim) → Control → plant → …
    - Control→plant (control_cmd) and plant→Control (pose 9 ms) are measured.
    - Perception(dummy)→Planning is present as objects → /simulation? NO: the
      dummy perception lives in /simulation, so its objects feed planning as
      "/simulation → …" — the namespace-based Layer B mislabels the dummy;
      map dummy_perception_publisher → /perception in the next pass.
    - Planning→Control: the msg edge planning_validator → controller_node_exe
      (/planning/trajectory) EXISTS in the graph but carries no flow_n / no age
      and controller_node_exe has NO state links. Reason (verified in the
      trace): Autoware's controller consumes trajectory/odometry/accel/steering
      through InterProcessPollingSubscriber — `take()` inside its 30 Hz timer,
      NO subscription callback. 20 912 rmw_take on /planning/trajectory in the
      controller pid, 100 % of them inside a callback window (the timer's).
      Our measure_flows pairs a take with the NEXT callback_start (≤5 ms) and
      detect_state_links needs a FIRED deposit callback → both miss polled
      subs. This is exactly the sample-and-hold read the design predicted,
      and it is directly measurable: data age = take_ts − source_timestamp,
      consumer = the enclosing callback (timer). ⇒ MODEL TODO (below).

Model TODO from cp_1
--------------------
  [ ] polled subscriptions: sub with rmw_take but no own callback_start →
      mark F/E as `polled`; in measure_flows attribute a take that lies inside
      an active callback window to that callback (owner()) as a SAMPLED read
      (age = take − source_ts); add the state/sampled edge sub-topic → owner F.
      Expected result: Planning→Control appears as sampled ×1, age ≈ tens of ms
      (33 Hz timer vs 10 Hz trajectory), plus /simulation→/control via
      controller_node_exe (currently only via callback-based control nodes).
  [ ] filter _ros2cli_* / ROSTopicHz nodes (injector tooling) out of the model
      or tag them as tooling.
  [ ] Layer B: component override map (dummy_perception_publisher → /perception,
      simple_planning_simulator → plant/ext) so the picture's boxes line up.
  [ ] ANALYZE after save (done in graph_store_pg) — r18 first /api/components
      call took 21 min before ANALYZE, 7 s after.
